verdict.rationale: Exa's pricing docs list a first-party capability for "Scheduled searches that surface new events on the web," so it offers recurring scheduled jobs of its own rather than a one-off async run. That is the only mention, and nothing describes how to configure a cadence, manage schedules, or schedule workflows beyond searches. Websets webhooks and async delivery are adjacent features and are not credited as scheduling. Missing for 10: documentation of schedule configuration (cron or interval), API or SDK endpoints for creating and managing recurring jobs, scheduling of broader workflows (e.g., Agent runs or Webset refreshes), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
